comments.author: Donce
comments.body: This map is very good to grind Search and Archaeology. You get the map at Scholar in Athens, sail about 2 minutes to Turkey West Coast, find the discovery (very easy to find), go back to Athens, report discovery to one of the nobles (pity you do not get QMP for reporting) and then go to Scholar again and repeat the same procedure :)

comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
I have one more tip how to grind Recognition and Geography. In Alexandria at Scholar you read Geography books and get Unfinished Map of Cyprus island which is located about 1 minute sail to the north of Alexandria. Although this map is only R3.

In the process you can also do a Research at Scholar about Discoveries to get Adventure exp, fame and Oxford credits after you finish the thesis.
